summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) union member; rich/control.py adds the title escape entry ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor (terminal check only, returns bool); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Not verified: tests were not run and Black formatting was not checked.
